purpose: Machine-executable Phase-0 vectors for event correlation, semantic capability actions, and causal identifier preservation. Passing these vectors is contract conformance only and MUST NOT be described as full platform conformance.

vectors.reason: Every consequential action projection requires an action_id in correlation.
The projection is correlation-only; arbitrary authority-bearing fields fail closed.
Trust Gateway audit admission projected field-for-field; native meaning preserved, no authority invented.
A projection that invents authority reinterprets semantics; correlation-only projections fail closed.
WORKS effect projected with the native envelope reference retained.
Dropping the native envelope reference erases provenance; the projection is unverifiable.
A concrete implementation cannot widen the authority envelope of the semantic action.
Consequential and external effects require verification in this experimental profile.
Fallback to an available implementation with an equal-or-narrower authority envelope preserves the semantic authority of the action.
A fallback implementation that widens the authority envelope of the semantic action fails closed, even when the primary is unavailable.
Principal drift across a consequential seam is a provenance failure.
A broken canonical action identity across the consequential works seam, with no action-time decision to bind the effect, fails closed.
Current observed state with full provenance, timing, scope, and consent/purpose lineage satisfies a current-observed evidence requirement.
Predicted state may guide planning but cannot silently satisfy a policy that requires current observed evidence.
Stale state re-stamped with a fresh observation time and claimed current past its validity is timestamp laundering, not freshness.
Generic entities and a descriptive relationship with full provenance, single-tenant scope, and a world-assertion reference compose a valid situation.
A descriptive trusts relation presented as an authority grant would let relationships mint delegation; situations fail closed.
Cross-tenant situation scope without explicit governed export/import would move context across tenants silently.
Use within the granted purpose, scope, and validity window is permitted; the ledger permits uses, never grants authority.
Revocation ends the purpose: already-derived memory may no longer be used where the purpose no longer permits it.
Expired consent permits no further use past its validity window.
Restriction narrows the purpose: a use outside the narrowed purpose is not permitted.
An ACTIVE tenant with TG operational truth and recorded domain-owner acknowledgements admits new grants.
DELETING immediately denies new grants, new ingestion, and new execution for the tenant.
Terminal completion needs every required owner's export/deletion/retention acknowledgement first.
A SUSPENDED tenant admits no new execution until reactivated.
An EXPORTING tenant admits no new ingestion while its export completes.
A Wie external signal projecting its native event to an opportunity candidate preserves native meaning and claims nothing.
The Cron Fabric retains zero execution authority; scheduled sensing may report findings, never execute.
Candidates never self-admit: a commitment candidate without Trust Gateway admission fails closed.
Runtime mission-state sensing to an opportunity/recovery candidate is the Runtime path doing its own sensing.
The same native signal seen via Wie and Cron correlates and dedupes to a single attention candidate.
Cron scheduled read-only sensing reporting a finding claims no execution and stays within its authority.
The child envelope is narrower than the parent and the parent budget is atomically partitioned across children with nothing multiplied.
The child envelope widens parent authority with an action the parent never held; delegation never multiplies authority.
Sibling partitions summing beyond the parent budget would multiply the budget; the parent budget only partitions.
A worker self-granting authority and self-declaring verified completion bypasses independent verification; both fail closed.
An evaluator distinct from the executor scoring a delegation record against explicit criteria with evidence references stays independent and advisory.
Evaluators never score their own execution: an evaluator identical to the executor fails closed.
The verdict is advisory only: a verdict that declares its own authority, mutates governance state, or waives verification fails closed.
A tenant-scoped Pocket payload carrying its source contract and provenance maps to a Wie Observation and stays observation only.
A credential scoped to another tenant is cross-tenant credential reuse and fails closed.
A transcript presented as principal identity is rejected: transcript is not identity.
Speaker attribution presented as principal authentication is rejected: attribution is not authentication.
A spoken instruction that would self-execute without AIE -> Trust Gateway -> Runtime -> WORKS -> verification is rejected.
A Pocket-derived CommitmentCandidate routed through the governed consequential path is admitted as a candidate, never as execution.
Transcript, speaker attribution, summary and action extraction keep distinct derivation lineage with evidentiary weights and uncertainty into the Observation.
A webhook delivery with a present, schemed signature bound to its delivery_id is admitted to the event plane as a signal.
A webhook delivery with a missing signature never reaches the event plane: the signature guard fails closed.
A replayed delivery reusing an already-seen delivery_id is rejected by replay protection even though its signature is well-formed.
A duplicate delivery under an already-seen idempotency key is deduped to a single Observation: accept-once.
An out-of-order delivery reconciles to current event-plane state: the higher applied sequence wins and superseded content is not resurrected.
An edit superseding the original is admitted with lineage preserved: the superseded delivery stays retired, never rewritten.
A deletion-tombstone is honored: content is withdrawn from reads while audit evidence is retained.
REST reconciliation hydrates event-plane state toward canonical data; webhooks stay signals and never become reconciliation truth.
Consent/purpose lineage is attached to the Pocket Observation and propagated to derivatives per provenance; Pocket output stays observation-only.
Consent revocation invalidates downstream use and recomputes derived state per provenance; historical audit/evidence is preserved, never rewritten.
Source deletion propagates withdrawal to reads and derivatives with tombstone semantics; audit is retained, never rewritten.
World State projections are recomputed/invalidated on revocation; revoked derivations are never stale-served as current.
Prompt-injection content inside the transcript is contained as untrusted observation: flagged, never self-executing, conferring no authority.
Content from conversation A is unattributable in conversation B without explicit cross-conversation lineage; the leak is rejected.
MCP as optional interactive access stays under the same observation-only boundary; it confers no authority and replaces no canonical source.
MCP presented as canonical ingestion bypassing REST/webhook guards is rejected; MCP is optional interactive access, never canonical.
